The '''Rachuk system''', also known as the '''Vladet system''', was located in the [[Rachuk sector/Legends|Rachuk sector]]. [[Vladet]] was located in this [[Star system/Legends|system]] and was also the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. The [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rachuk]] was also located here.
